object_valid_fraction.why: object pose lost on too many frames

hand_valid_fraction.why: no hand tracked for most of the clip

camera_speed_max_mps.why: camera jumps faster than a head moves (SLAM failure)

camera_turn_max_radps.why: camera turns faster than a head turns (SLAM failure)

object_extent_max_m.why: object size implausible for a hand-held object (scale or unit error)

hand_object_gap_p20_m.why: wrists are within 6 cm of the object on fewer than 20% of frames (hand or object depth/scale wrong)

wrist_inside_object_fraction.why: wrists sit inside the object (object pose or scale wrong)

object_mask_fraction.why: the object is not segmented on most frames

object_iou_median.why: posed object mesh does not cover the object's mask

object_iou_p10.why: posed object mesh misses the object's mask on a tenth of frames

wrist_on_hand_mask_fraction.why: wrists do not project onto their hand's mask

hand_frame_fraction.why: hands visible on too few frames

hand_size_median.why: hands too small in frame (not a close-up egocentric view)

exposure_ok_fraction.why: too many under- or over-exposed frames

frozen_fraction.why: too many repeated frames (static camera, stalled capture, or a screen recording)

cut_count.why: scene cuts: more than one shot in the clip
